Additional comments:
How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: I followed a link through the UC website. I choose my classes almost like I would choose clothes when online shopping. Put my classes in a "basket" and put a request in for the classes.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: Emails that reminded me of searching and lots of describtion about the classes.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: I got all the classes I wanted.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Do it as soon as the registration opens.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA courses at your host university? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: I studied at Berkeley which has a rumor of being very good academically. I was dissapointed because the students were not critical thinking. The students are very young and bond with their teachers personally. They go to office hours and you some students shared their problems with the professor. That was weird.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Big classes, no breaks. More homework. Grading system.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer: History and practice of human rights, rhetoric of the image, language and movements

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: History and practice of human rights

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer: Try to stay in San Francisco before the school starts, travel around in california if you get the chance and take courses you actually find interesting because you are gonna do a lot of homework in the class
